evaluate_masks: evaluate segmentation masks against a COCO json dataset and return COCO evaluation results
evaluate_boxes: evaluate bounding box detections against a COCO json dataset and return COCO evaluation results
evaluate_keypoints: evaluate keypoint detections against a COCO json dataset and return COCO evaluation results
evaluate_body_uv: evaluate DensePose body UV predictions against a COCO json dataset and return evaluation results
evaluate_box_proposals: evaluate detection proposal recall metrics for region proposals against ground truth boxes
